instruction: Together lift the gray kitchenpot with rounded edges up

source.instruction: Together lift the gray kitchenpot with rounded edges up

arm_note: ARM CHOICE in this demonstration: the LEFT arm grasped the pot, which was at x = -2 (left half of the table); the RIGHT arm grasped the pot, which was at x = -2 (left half of the table). The arm was chosen by the object's x position (x < 0 -> LEFT arm, x > 0 -> RIGHT arm; each arm reaches only ~15 cm past the centre line). In YOUR scene the objects may be on the other side: choose the arm from your own object positions, not from the demonstration.

frames.label: turn 1
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.93; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.93; table z = 74
frames.plan: Partially close both grippers to prepare for grasping the pot handles.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips stayed in place, now 34 cm (horizontal) / +16 cm (vertical) from the pot; closed the gripper (opening 0.38: holding the pot); RIGHT fingertips stayed in place, now 37 cm (horizontal) / +16 cm (vertical) from the pot; closed the gripper (opening 0.40: holding the pot)

frames.label: turn 2
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.38; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.40; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move left arm forward and inward, and rotate gripper to align with the left handle.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+14, +19, -0) cm, now 14 cm (horizontal) / +16 cm (vertical) from the pot

frames.label: turn 3
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-16, -1, 94) opening 0.37; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.37; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower left arm toward handle height z=84 and move right arm closer to right handle.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+0, -0, -10) cm, now 14 cm (horizontal) / +6 cm (vertical) from the pot; RIGHT fingertips moved by (-18, +19, -0) cm, now 14 cm (horizontal) / +16 cm (vertical) from the pot

frames.label: turn 4
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-16, -1, 84) opening 0.37; RIGHT fingertips (13, -0, 94) opening 0.37; table z = 74
frames.plan: Orient right gripper and lower it to z=84 to align with right handle.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-1, -0, -10) cm, now 14 cm (horizontal) / +6 cm (vertical) from the pot

frames.label: turn 5
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-16, -1, 84) opening 0.37; RIGHT fingertips (12, -1, 84) opening 0.37; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move left gripper slightly closer and lower to envelop the left handle.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+2, +1, -2) cm, now 12 cm (horizontal) / +4 cm (vertical) from the pot

frames.label: turn 6
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-13, -0, 82) opening 0.37; RIGHT fingertips (12, -1, 84) opening 0.37; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move right gripper onto right handle and close both grippers completely to grasp.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips stayed in place, now 12 cm (horizontal) / +4 cm (vertical) from the pot; closed the gripper (opening 0.06: holding the pot); RIGHT fingertips moved by (-2, +0, -1) cm, now 12 cm (horizontal) / +5 cm (vertical) from the pot; closed the gripper (opening 0.06: holding the pot)

frames.label: turn 7
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-13, -0, 82) opening 0.06; RIGHT fingertips (10, -0, 83) opening 0.06; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lift left arm up by 7.5 cm to lift the pot off the table.
